{{Quote|Those Sand Splitters once again. I had no idea they stole so much when they left, but they've now gotten Jabba's attention.|[[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPRY" />}}
The '''Sand Splitters''' were a group of criminals who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Saul Rouse]] and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Erib Kurrugh]] were both members of the organization.<ref name="SWG:JPRY" />

==History==
{{Quote|Yeah, we caught one of them as they were escaping. The Sarlacc had a nice little snack that day, but the rest of them got away.|Ree-Yees, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPRY" />}}
[[File:SandSplitterCave2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Sand Splitter Cave]], home to a number of knaves and brutes]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Sand Spittlers stole a book, a bell and a prototype warhead known as [[the Candle]] from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], and took the items to a [[Sand Splitter Cave|cave]] in the Tatooine desert. However, Jabba's associciate [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]] hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover the items from the Sand Splitters.<ref name="SWG:JPRY" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sand Splitters appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPRY" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sand Splitters were added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPRY" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
